panels.description: Requests the llama.cpp server is processing right now.
panels.title: Active Requests

panels.description: Requests waiting in the queue because every slot is busy. A growing value means demand exceeds capacity — add a replica or reduce context length.
panels.title: Deferred Requests

panels.description: Prompt processing speed in tokens per second across the fleet, shown only while requests are running.
panels.title: Prompt Throughput

panels.description: Text generation speed in tokens per second across the fleet, shown only while requests are running.
panels.title: Generation Throughput

panels.description: Average share of slots busy per decode. Near 1.0 means the server is saturated and new requests will queue.
panels.title: Busy Slots per Decode

panels.description: Largest context length currently loaded across servers — useful to confirm a preset change took effect.
panels.title: Largest Context Seen

panels.description: Prompt processing speed per server over time. Flat at zero means idle, not broken.
panels.title: Throughput Prompt

panels.description: Generation speed per server over time. The number users experience as response fluency.
panels.title: Throughput Generation

panels.description: Average milliseconds per token. Rising values under constant load mean slower responses — check memory pressure or thermal throttling on the node.
panels.title: Latency per Token

panels.description: Requests the llama.cpp server is processing right now.
panels.title: Active Requests

panels.description: Requests waiting in the queue because every slot is busy. A growing value means demand exceeds capacity — add a replica or reduce context length.
panels.title: Deferred Requests

panels.description: Average share of slots busy per decode. Near 1.0 means the server is saturated and new requests will queue.
panels.title: Busy Slots

panels.description: Average tokens produced per decode call. Low values under load are normal — batching splits a decode across many requests.
panels.title: Tokens per Decode

panels.description: Decode calls per second — how often the server runs a decoding step.
panels.title: Decode Calls/sec

panels.description: Milliseconds per input (prompt) token. Prompt processing is compute-bound; expect lower values on nodes with faster memory bandwidth.
panels.title: Prompt Latency

panels.description: Milliseconds per output (generated) token. This dominates perceived chat latency.
panels.title: Generation Latency

panels.description: Cumulative prompt tokens processed per server. Read the rate, not the absolute value.
panels.title: prompt_tokens_total

panels.description: Cumulative generated tokens per server.
panels.title: tokens_predicted_total

panels.description: Cumulative seconds spent processing prompts per server.
panels.title: prompt_seconds_total

panels.description: Cumulative seconds spent generating tokens per server.
panels.title: tokens_predicted_seconds_total

panels.description: Cumulative decode calls per server — the denominator for Tokens per Decode.
panels.title: n_decode_total
